integration_days.focus: Prologue to Oakhaven arrival on Beginner, focus: regression hunting
steps: Pull main, then build the exe: powershell -File AethelgardPrototype/tools/export_windows.ps1 -Tour; keep the tour log and screenshots in production/qa/evidence/<YYYY-MM-DD>-weekly/; any tour failure becomes today's first bug

Run every suite: powershell -File AethelgardPrototype/tests/run_all_tests.ps1 (no -Quick), including reachability_test.gd, plus the gdUnit4 run (GdUnitCmdTool.gd -a res://tests) once installed; record pass/fail per suite
Set difficulty to Beginner. Play from New Game through the Flight 707 cinematic and the crash sequence (scripts/prologue/) to the ch1_opening_crash_site_hook and ch1_path_to_oakhaven
Stop at the Oakhaven village entrance; note time-to-control and every skip used
Focus - regression hunting: Re-test every bug closed in the last two weeks along the route; reopen any that reproduce
Run /playtest-report on today's notes and save it to production/qa/playtest-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md
Run /bug-triage on new and open bugs, then /sprint-status for the week's burndown and risks
Fix the top 2-3 bugs (S1/S2 first), each with a regression test; re-run the affected suite and re-export if the build changed
integration_days.done: Exe built and toured, all suites recorded, 'Prologue to Oakhaven arrival' played end to end on Beginner with regression hunting notes, playtest report and triage saved, top bugs fixed or scheduled.

Run every suite: powershell -File AethelgardPrototype/tests/run_all_tests.ps1 (no -Quick), including reachability_test.gd, plus the gdUnit4 run (GdUnitCmdTool.gd -a res://tests) once installed; record pass/fail per suite
Set difficulty to Hard. Play Chapter 1 from a fresh save to the Chapter 2 hand-off without debug shortcuts
Record total time, deaths, and every moment of confusion
Focus - controller only: Unplug the keyboard and mouse; play with a pad including all menus; log any action unreachable or any wrong glyph
Run /playtest-report on today's notes and save it to production/qa/playtest-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md
Run /bug-triage on new and open bugs, then /sprint-status for the week's burndown and risks
Fix the top 2-3 bugs (S1/S2 first), each with a regression test; re-run the affected suite and re-export if the build changed
integration_days.done: Exe built and toured, all suites recorded, 'Chapter 1 end to end' played end to end on Hard with controller only notes, playtest report and triage saved, top bugs fixed or scheduled.

steps: Run /milestone-review against the current phase in ROADMAP_10_YEAR.md; list exit criteria met / not met with evidence links.
Compare planned vs actual stream-days for the month (from the day plans and active.md logs); compute slip % per stream.
Run /tech-debt and /asset-audit; record the debt register delta (new, closed, net) and orphaned-asset count.
Run /regression-suite and /test-evidence-review; list fixed bugs that still lack a regression test.
Update the risk register (ROADMAP section 13): re-rate likelihood and impact for every risk; add any new risk seen this month.
Review energy log: average energy, count of <= 2 days, reduced-load days taken. If the average is under 3, schedule 2 lighter days in the next week.
Back up: verify the git remote is up to date, the off-site LFS copy is current and PAE project files are archived; test-restore one file.
Update CHANGELOG.md with the month's player-visible and internal changes; run /changelog to cross-check.
Write a 1-page monthly note in production/ (what shipped, what slipped, what is next) and pick the top 3 priorities for next month.
monthly_review.done: Monthly note committed, risk register and debt register updated, backups verified with a test restore, next month's top 3 priorities written in active.md.

steps: Read the last three monthly notes and the current phase's exit criteria; list which criteria are at risk.
Measure velocity: completed stream-days vs planned for the quarter; compare measured cost per unit (quest, boss, region chunk, track) against the ROADMAP section 3 budget.
Run /scope-check against the roadmap; list additions since the last quarter and their cost.
Apply the cut order (ROADMAP) if the projection overshoots: name each cut, its saving in stream-days, and record it as an ADR via /architecture-decision.
Re-sequence the next quarter's tasks with /sprint-plan; put dependencies first and leave 10% buffer per stream.
Re-check external facts flagged 'check current rules' (store, rating, platform) that fall in the next quarter; note what must be verified and when.
Review sustainability: energy averages, reduced-load days, rest; adjust the next quarter's daily load if the average energy is under 3.
Update production/session-state/active.md and the roadmap's 'next two weeks' list with the new plan.
quarterly_replan.done: Re-plan ADR (or 'no change' note) committed, next quarter sprint plan written, cuts and their savings recorded, sustainability adjustment decided.

start_of_day: Energy check: rate today 1-5 and write it as the first line of production/session-state/active.md. If the last 3 entries are all <= 2, cut today's load to the primary stream only (no secondary, no study), keep the hygiene block, and stop by mid-afternoon.
Read production/session-state/active.md (yesterday's last-touch, blockers, next step) before opening anything else.
git status and git log --oneline -5 on the current branch; confirm no uncommitted work from yesterday is waiting for a decision.
Run powershell -File AethelgardPrototype/tests/run_all_tests.ps1 -Quick (or the gdUnit4 quick suite once installed) and note any red suite before starting new work.
Open today's day plan; restate the primary and secondary 'done-when' lines in active.md so the session has a fixed target.
Check the bug tracker for any S1/S2 reported since yesterday; if one exists it replaces the buffer task for today.
Set a timer for the first focused block (3-4 h) and close chat, mail and store pages for its duration.
Glance at the risk register's top 3 and ask: does today's work make any of them worse?
end_of_day: Write the 3-line log in active.md: what changed, what's blocked, what's next (with file paths).
Run the full suite (tests/run_all_tests.ps1) if any code changed today; record the result in active.md.
git diff --check, then stage and propose commits in Conventional Commits format referencing the task ID; commit only after approval.
Move today's evidence screenshots into production/qa/evidence/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ and delete scratch captures that are not evidence.
Update the task's day status in the plan (done / partially done / slipped) honestly; a slipped day moves to tomorrow's buffer slot, not to tonight.
Note one fun/feel observation from the day in the playtest notes file, even if it is small.
Energy check (evening): rate 1-5 and note sleep target. If today was <= 2 and the previous 2 days were too, mark tomorrow as a reduced-load day in active.md now.
Push the branch to the remote backup (and confirm OneDrive/LFS sync has finished before shutting down).
Stop at the planned time. Unfinished steps are written down, not finished late.
